name: Kadapa

queries.query: Kadapa Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map GIS land records survey parcels
queries.result: Found first-party Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha, APSAC cadastral-map application, the official YSR Kadapa district administration site, and official APSAC GIS service documentation. The current public cadastral application exposes a cached ArcGIS map service covering Andhra Pradesh; it does not expose a queryable parcel feature layer or native parcel IDs.

portals.name: APSAC AP Cadastral Map
portals.operator: Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre, Government of Andhra Pradesh
portals.observation: Current public ArcGIS Web AppBuilder configuration was inspected. It references the public cached cadastral map service https://apsac.ap.gov.in/gisserver/rest/services/REVENUE/cadastral_ap_cache/MapServer. The service metadata reports one Parcel layer, Web Mercator (EPSG:3857/102100), and tiled-map capabilities, with no feature-layer fields or native IDs.

requests.result: Current public app configuration fetched. Web map item b54a4a9a00b441a2bdd8f993d140edd5 and cadastral_ap_cache map service identified.
Operational layer configuration confirms the public cadastral map service URL and title cadastral_ap_cache.

Service metadata fetched. One Parcel map layer; spatial reference WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857; cached tiled map; no query capability, fields, object ID, or GeoJSON feature response. A pjson request returned 403, while JSON metadata was available.

Anonymous raster export returned an image URL for a 2 km Web Mercator extent centered on the exact WUP point after coordinate conversion. This is raster map evidence only; it does not establish a parcel identity or provide retained geometry.
Direct HTTPS request timed out. No login, credentials, TLS bypass, or repeated private route was attempted.

registryBasis: Official Andhra Pradesh cadastral mapping sources were evidenced, including a first-party Bhunaksha portal and APSAC's current public cadastral map application. Kadapa-specific parcel coverage and feature querying remain unverified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The APSAC service is an Andhra Pradesh cadastral map service with a statewide-looking full extent in Web Mercator; the Bhunaksha portal describes Andhra Pradesh cadastral mapping and integration with land records.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A public cached map service and a bounded raster export were verified. Kadapa parcel feature coverage, schema, native IDs, and citywide completeness were not verified.

technicalBlocker: The current APSAC endpoint is a cached ArcGIS map service with one rendered Parcel layer but no queryable feature-layer schema or native identity fields. Bhunaksha direct access timed out. The successful exact-point-area request returned raster PNG metadata only.
remainingUncertainty: The state portal may support parcel selection through UI or another endpoint not exposed by the current public app configuration. No exact-point parcel hit or citywide absence inference is made.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may inspect a documented anonymous Bhunaksha/APSAC feature endpoint if one becomes available, confirming schema, CRS, native identity, and safe fields before retaining geometry.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
